launch.description: A verified release installs into /Applications and opens a native Nix Mac window.

steps.description: Wait for a native application window
args:
tell application "System Events"
repeat 60 times
if exists process "nixmac" then
tell process "nixmac"
if (count of windows) > 0 then return "nixmac window ready"
end tell
end if
delay 1
end repeat
error "nixmac did not open a window"
end tell

steps.description: Wait for the rendered onboarding screen
steps.name: nixmac-window

startup-recovery.description: Load the startup-recovery initial state, reconcile an interrupted onboarding completion, and show the missing-configuration repair view after hydration.

steps.description: Verify the intended pre-launch recovery state
args: ObjC.import('Foundation'); const stateDir = ObjC.unwrap($.NSHomeDirectory()) + '/Library/Application Support/com.darkmatter.nixmac/'; function readState(name) { return JSON.parse(ObjC.unwrap($.NSString.stringWithContentsOfFileEncodingError(stateDir + name, $.NSUTF8StringEncoding, null))); } const onboarding = readState('onboarding-state.json'); const preferences = readState('global-preferences.json'); if (onboarding.completedAt !== null || onboarding.lastBuildAt !== 1751967600 || preferences.configDir !== '/tmp/nixmac-desktop-missing-config') throw new Error('startup-recovery requires its initial-state fixture'); 'nixmac recovery seed verified';

steps.description: Require the seeded missing configuration to have no flake
Launch Nix Mac with the seeded on-disk state
Wait for the hydrated repair view
steps.name: startup-recovery-window

steps.description: Verify the repair view identifies the supplied configuration path
steps.name: startup-recovery-path

steps.description: Verify Nix Mac persisted the recovered completion timestamp
args:
nixmac_state_dir="$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.darkmatter.nixmac"
nixmac_completed=$(/usr/bin/plutil -extract completedAt raw -o - "$nixmac_state_dir/onboarding-state.json")
/bin/test "$nixmac_completed" = 1751967600
/bin/cp "$nixmac_state_dir/onboarding-state.json" /tmp/nixmac-desktop-recovered-onboarding.json
/bin/cp "$nixmac_state_dir/global-preferences.json" /tmp/nixmac-desktop-loaded-preferences.json
/usr/bin/printf 'nixmac recovered completion: %s\n' "$nixmac_completed"

steps.description: Retain the loaded preferences for reproduction
steps.name: loaded-preferences.json

package-tools.description: Nix and Homebrew are usable from the prepared desktop, and Nix Mac opens alongside them.

steps.description: Inspect the rendered onboarding screen on the configured desktop
steps.name: package-tools-window
